{{Quote|I hope you told Master Plo not to destroy this facility until we get off of it.''"<br />"''Yeah. All of us, and the slaves.''"<br />"''We'll need a bigger ship.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, as the Republic forces begin their attack|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Having occupied the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colony world of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] secretly transferred the world's entire population to the planet [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], where the Togruta were to be sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] at an auction. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Battle of Kiros|liberated]] Kiros and discovered links leading to Zygerria. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] soon [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|infiltrated]] the auction and tried to rescue the Togruta but were captured by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] and enslaved. Skywalker and his Padawan, however, escaped from the Zygerrians and headed for Kadavo to rescue Kenobi, CT-7567, and the Togruta, who had been transferred to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Zygerrian slave processing facility]] on the planet. While en route, the two also called for reinforcements from the Republic.

Tano and her Master arrived on the planet first on the [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|Zygerrian slave ship]] [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']] and tried to break into the slave processing facility. When ordered to cease by the Zygerrian [[Keeper/Legends|Keeper]] [[Agruss/Legends|Agruss]], lest the slaves be [[Death/Legends|killed]], Skywalker did not comply. At that moment, the reinforcements arrived, led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] and Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. Koon's [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] detachment attacked the facility with [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]], but were halted by its [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses. However, Skywalker was able to destroy the defensive towers, while Kenobi and CT-7567 rebelled and killed Agruss. As a last act before his death, the Keeper tried to throw the Togruta into the volcanic crevice below the facility, but, following a plan devised by Tano, the Republic forces evacuated them on Admiral Coburn's [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]], the [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']]. After picking up Skywalker, Kenobi, Tano, and CT-7567, the Republic strike team destroyed the slave facility.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Kenobi is coming to realize, perhaps for the first time in his life, that his efforts to help others will only injure them. As plans for escape and hopes of rescue fade, the gnawing fear that he will never be able to take action will grow in Kenobi's heart. To ease the burden of his fellow slaves, defiance will become compliance. When Kenobi realizes he cannot help those around him, his spirit will break, and he will be mine!|Queen Miraj Scintel|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Escape from Kadavo Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] occupied the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and secretly transferred its entire population to the planet [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], where they were to be sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] at an auction held by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Battle of Kiros|liberated]] Kiros and found clues that led them to Zygerria.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

[[File:RexTogrutasKadavo.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Rex and Obi-Wan Kenobi being processed on Kadavo.]]
Posing as slave traders, Skywalker, Kenobi, Tano and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]&mdash;nicknamed "Rex"&mdash;[[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|infiltrated]] the auction and tried to rescue the Togruta but ended up being caught by the Zygerrians and becoming slaves themselves. While Skywalker was left in service of Queen Scintel, Tano was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on Zygerria, and Kenobi and Rex were transferred along with the Togruta to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Zygerrian slave processing facility]] on the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Commanded by the Zygerrian [[Keeper/Legends|Keeper]] [[Agruss/Legends|Agruss]], the processing facility was kept aloft above a pool of [[Magma/Legends|lava]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic" />

On Kadavo, the Keeper tried to break Kenobi's will by dropping several Togruta into the lava and promising to do the same with the other slaves should the Jedi attempt to rebel.<ref name="Slaves of the Republic" /> Unwilling to put the innocent in danger, Kenobi and Rex were eventually forced to submit to the Keeper after the [[Royal Zygerrian guard/Legends|Zygerrian guards]] began torturing the Togruta for Kenobi's defiance. Skywalker and Tano soon escaped from Zygerria and headed for Kadavo to rescue Kenobi and the Togruta, also summoning reinforcements commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]].<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

==The battle==
===The Republic's infiltration===
{{Quote|Anakin, you must realize this is a fight you cannot win alone.''"<br />"''Who said I was alone?|Kenobi begging Skywalker to stand down to prevent the death of the slaves|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
Back on Kadavo, the Keeper was contacted by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and ordered to execute his Republic prisoners. Agruss summoned both Kenobi and Rex to the facility's command center and told the two about his intention to dispose of them. While the Keeper communicated with Kenobi and Rex, Skywalker and Tano arrived on the captured [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|Zygerrian slave ship]] [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']]. As the two Jedi and their [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] disembarked from the craft, heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] that guarded the facility destroyed the ''Tecora''. Taking cover near the facility's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]], Skywalker and Tano activated their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and started cutting through them. Acting on Dooku's orders, the Keeper positioned the Togrutan slaves on a platform above the lava pool and threatened to dump them to their deaths unless Skywalker surrendered. In response, Skywalker summoned his reinforcements.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

The [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]] [[Hand of Justice/Legends|''Hand of Justice'']],<ref name="TCWEG" /> commanded by Admiral Coburn, descended into the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. While Coburn's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] remained in orbit, launching [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by members of the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]], a clone detachment under the command of Jedi General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. Koon himself flew his personal [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], the ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]''. As the Wolfpack attacked the facility, the Zygerrian guards scrambled to its defense, launching their two nimble [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]] into battle. The Zygerrian pilots damaged [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog's]] craft, but General Koon outmaneuvered them and destroyed the Starhoppers. The Wolfpack then focused on destroying the defensive towers, which had already taken down one LAAT/i gunship. However, the turrets were ray-shielded, and the Republic forces were unable to inflict any damage.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

===The Zygerrians' downfall===
[[File:SkywalkerTanoKadavo.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Tano break into the slave processing facility.]]
Rex and Kenobi took advantage of the confusion caused by their allies' arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. They broke free of their restraints and assaulted their Zygerrian captors, while Skywalker, Tano, and R2-D2 broke into the facility. As Kenobi and Rex continued to battle their guards, Agruss used his computer to electrify the walls of the slave pens holding the Togruta and opened the hatch beneath the pens, intent on dropping the slaves to their doom. Agruss then smashed the controls so that Kenobi could not cancel his command. Kenobi contacted Koon, informing him of the situation. In turn, Koon communicated with Skywalker, warning him that the cruiser could not descend any further to rescue the Togruta until the turrets were destroyed. Skywalker then set off to destroy the towers, while Tano went to help the slaves.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker [[Telekinesis/Legends|leaped]] onto one of the towers, killed its gunner, and used the weapon to destroy all other emplacements, opening the way for Admiral Coburn. However, as there was no way to bring the slaves onto the landing platform, Tano advised the Admiral to position the ''Hand of Justice'' under the facility, beneath the opened slave pens. In the meantime, Kenobi and Rex managed to defeat the remaining Zygerrian guards, leaving only Agruss. In hopes of saving his life, the Keeper reminded Kenobi of his inability to kill an unarmed man due to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. However, [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] Rex was not bound by the Code, and he killed Agruss with a throw of a force spear. After Admiral Coburn maneuvered his ship underneath the facility, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] and the Wolfpack used [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and ascension cables to help transport the slaves and Tano onto the ''Hand of Justice''. After Skywalker, Kenobi and Rex were evacuated aboard one of the gunships, and the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] carrying the Togruta left the facility, Koon ordered all gunships to open fire, and the slave processing facility was destroyed.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Ahsoka, you have done a great deed for your people today.''"<br />"''You're sad?''"<br />"''Well, you and the Jedi have done your best, but I do not think our people will recover from this horror anytime soon.''"<br />"''I understand, but in the end, surviving this will only strengthen your people.''"<br />"''Perhaps. And perhaps the people of Kiros will also join the Republic.''"<br />"''I think that's a wise choice, Governor.|Tano and Roshti, conversing after the battle|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
The Zygerrian Slave Empire was dealt a crippling blow with the destruction of the slave processing facility. Shortly after the battle, aboard the Republic cruiser, the leader of the rescued slaves, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]], thanked Tano for her service to the Togruta. Although Roshti believed that his people would not recover from the horrors they had been through soon, he admitted that Tano could be right in that those events would only make the Togruta of Kiros stronger. Roshti then told Tano that he and his people were considering joining the Republic; a notion which the Padawan supported.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Kadavo was first depicted in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]], written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]]. The battle served as a conclusion to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'' story arc]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''The Clone Wars'' comic series]].<ref name="Slaves6">[[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]]</ref> In [[2011]]-[[2012]], the comic books were adapted into three episodes of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. The third episode of the arc, "[[Escape from Kadavo]],"<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> aired on [[January 6]] of 2012,<ref name="TCWEG" /> featured the battle. However, the television episodes differed from the original storyline of the comic books in a number of ways.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> This article currently describes the battle as portrayed in the TV series, while the original material is presented below.

===Comic book portrayal===
====Skywalker's mission====
A major plot point in the comic book series that is absent from the on-screen adaptation is Dooku attempting to impair the reputation of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by spreading word that during the battle on Kiros, the Jedi eradicated the entire planet's population.<ref name="Slaves2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref> As such, Skywalker's escape from Zygerria and his attempt to liberate the slaves on Kadavo puts Dooku at risk of being exposed as a liar. In order to prevent that from happening, Dooku sends his servants&mdash;the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;alongside a Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to kill everyone on Kadavo&ndash;Republic, Zygerrian and Togruta alike.<ref name="Slaves6" />

The Republic forces under Skywalker's command, consisting of several ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], arrive at Kadavo. Backed by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Skywalker and Tano board a Zygerrian [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and use it to reach the Zygerrian Labor Processing Hub, which is guarded by a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]&mdash;who assume that the transport is delivering new slaves&mdash;are caught off guard by the appearance of the Jedi and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], and are quickly destroyed before they could react to the threat. Reaching the main door to the complex, Skywalker starts cutting his way in, but he is contacted by the Keeper and ordered to stop, or risk the slaves being killed. Desperate to rescue the slaves, Skywalker ignored the Keeper's threats and continued cutting into the facility.<ref name="Slaves6" />

====Separatist fleet arrives====
Meanwhile, the Separatist fleet arrives and [[Space warfare/Legends|engages]] the Republic task force above the planet. Leading several [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], Ventress&mdash;in her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']]&mdash;attacks the Republic [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], killing several pilots, including [[Shadow Three (Kadavo)|Shadow Three]] and [[Shadow Five]]. While General Grievous' fleet, consisting of a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], fights the Republic forces, Ventress and the ''Hyena''-class bombers head toward the Labor Processing Hub, intent on destroying it. Believing that the Confederacy has come to aid him, the Keeper once again demands Skywalker's surrender, and Skywalker reluctantly agrees.<ref name="Slaves6" />

[[File:BattleofKadavo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Hyena''-class bombers attack the Zygerrian Labor Processing Hub.]]
However, the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] proceed to [[Bombing run|attack]] the hub, destroying one of the cables that holds the facility above the volcanic crevice. As a result of this, the whole facility begins to incline, causing several Togruta slaves to lose their balance and fall into the lava to their deaths. Having witnessed the bombers attacking the hub, the Keeper realizes that Dooku's intention is to kill the slaves. In hopes that the Confederate forces would spare the Zygerrians if they disposed of the Togruta themselves, the Keeper tries to activate a mechanism that would dump the remaining slaves into the lava as well. Kenobi and Rex attack the Zygerrians that are guarding them, subduing the Keeper and preventing him from exterminating the population of Kiros. Kenobi damages the dumping mechanism, but the Togruta still remain in danger on a platform above the lava pool.<ref name="Slaves6" />

====Republic reinforcements====
In the meantime, more Republic forces arrive at Kadavo, forcing General Grievous to sound a retreat, thus leaving Ventress to fend off on her own. As the bombers initiate another attack on the facility, Skywalker orders his clone trooper escort to open fire. One [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot hits an enemy bomber's [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]], causing the [[Bomb/Legends|explosive]] to detonate and sparking a chain reaction that destroys most of the bombers. Distraught, Ventress tries to request more ''Hyena''-class [[Droid starfighter/Legends|fighters]] from Grievous, only to find out that the droid general has abandoned her. With the rest of the Confederate forces having fled, Ventress remains to battle the Republic alone. Meanwhile, Kenobi and Rex join with Skywalker and inform him of the danger that the Togruta are in. Having noticed Skywalker's transport, Kenobi quickly formulates a plan to rescue the slaves. Positioning the vessel immediately below the Togruta, the Jedi assemble on the ship's roof and use the Force to levitate the slaves onto the transport.<ref name="Slaves6" />

At that moment, Ventress's ''Trident'' performs an attack run on the Jedi's ship. The Jedi deflect her shots with their lightsabers, but Ventress clamps her ship onto the transport and uses her ship's claws to attack the Republic forces. Rex tries to destroy the ''Trident'' with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]], while Skywalker and Kenobi fight back with their lightsabers, but neither tactic works, and Ventress corners the Jedi. As she is preparing to deliver a killing blow, however, a group of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], led by Plo Koon, attacks the ''Trident'' and forces Ventress to retreat.<ref name="Slaves6" />

====Aftermath====
{{Quote|Our vision of a world without weapons has failed miserably. In this galaxy, we must walk the path of warriors whether we wish to or not.|Roshti, in the comic series|<ref name="Slaves6" />}}
[[File:RexTrainsTogrutas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|CT-7567 trains the Togruta in the use of blasters.]]
With the battle over, the Republic utilizes LAAT/i gunships to evacuate the Togruta and to secure the captured Keeper. The Republic then plants explosive charges throughout the facility to destroy it. Before the explosives are triggered, however, the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] are informed that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] has requested them to leave the Labor Processing Hub intact for later use. Realizing that the facility could only be used for one purpose&mdash;to house slaves&mdash;the Jedi decide to disobey Palpatine's direct order and destroy it.<ref name="Slaves6" />

The Republic helps the Togruta return to Kiros. To protect the colony against another possible invasion, the Republic stations a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of clone troopers on the planet. The Togruta, however, feel that the clones' presence might not be enough to protect them and decide to change their peaceful way of life, arming themselves and receiving combat education from the Republic troops.<ref name="Slaves6" />
